description: Fund performance multiples for an LP or a fund: TVPI (total value to paid-in), DPI (distributions to paid-in, realized) and RVPI (NAV to paid-in, unrealized). Use moic for a single deal and xirr for time-weighted returns. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/tvpi-dpi-calculator

commitment_usd.description: Total commitment, used only for the called percentage. 0 if unknown.

distributions_usd.description: Cumulative cash and stock distributed to date.

nav_usd.description: Latest reported residual value (net asset value).

paid_in_usd.description: Capital called and contributed to date, including fees.

name: tvpi_dpi
title: TVPI and DPI calculator
